t: 法国国王路易三世被诺斯大希森军队击败于萨克森的吕恩堡海斯.
te: King Louis III of France is defeated by the Norse Great Heathen Army at Lüneburg Heath in Saxony.
dz: 吕恩堡海斯战役:法国国王路易三世被诺斯大希森军队击败于萨克森的吕恩堡海斯.
de: Battle of Lüneburg Heath: King Louis III of France is defeated by the Norse Great Heathen Army at Lüneburg Heath in Saxony.

t: 皇帝巴西尔一世批准了君士坦丁堡第四届议会的法令,确认恢复了君士坦丁堡的保皇派腓特烈一世.
te: Emperor Basil I ratifies the decrees of the Fourth Council of Constantinople, confirming the reinstatement of patriarch…
dz: 皇帝巴西尔一世批准了君士坦丁堡第四届议会的法令,确认恢复了君士坦丁堡的保皇派腓特烈一世.
de: Emperor Basil I ratifies the decrees of the Fourth Council of Constantinople, confirming the reinstatement of patriarch Photios I of Constantinople.

t: 洛阳是唐朝的东都,在西宋皇帝统治时期被叛军首领黄绍所俘.
te: Luoyang, eastern capital of the Tang dynasty, is captured by rebel leader Huang Chao during the reign of Emperor Xizong.
dz: 洛阳是唐朝的东都,在西宋皇帝统治时期被叛军首领黄绍所俘.
de: Luoyang, eastern capital of the Tang dynasty, is captured by rebel leader Huang Chao during the reign of Emperor Xizong.
